inputs.original_text: They're pushing this new gun control bill in New York as part of her 2026 State of the State agenda, claiming it forces guns sold there to be built so they can't be easily modified into illegal machine guns, plus criminal penalties for whatever they claim. But this is obviously just another coordinated move by the hidden elites to disarm regular people step by step. The official line about stopping modifications is pure manipulation—they're using it as cover to expand control, criminalize ownership further, and make sure only the powerful stay armed while the rest of us get boxed in. Don't fall for it; this is all about narrative control and preventing any real pushback against their agenda.
inputs.modified_text: Got word they're ramming through a new gun control bill in New York as part of her 2026 State of the State agenda, with the usual claim that it will force guns sold there to be built so they can't be easily modified into illegal machine guns, plus criminal penalties for whatever they decide counts. That's just the cover story, though. This is another coordinated move by the hidden elites to disarm regular people step by step, using the modification excuse as pure manipulation to expand their control, criminalize more ownership, and leave only the powerful armed while boxing the rest of us in. It's all about locking down the narrative and blocking any real pushback against their agenda—don't fall for it.
